pieces.Text: As a swift action, you can manifest a pair of translucent, cloud-like wings that grant you a fly speed of 60 feet with good maneuverability. You can use these wings for
minute(s) per day. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments.
As a swift action, you can manifest a pair of translucent, cloud-like wings that grant you a fly speed of 90 feet with perfect maneuverability. You can use these wings for
minute(s) per day. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments.
